description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - bath watch: an attention-outsourcing tub watcher - stand at the tub and register it once, bound to a head heading with your own fill-time estimate; a pre-alert calls you at 80 percent and a full alert at 100 percent, by direction, and stays until you walk back and look at the tub (or tap ACK); an optional omnidirectional level watch nudges you once if the water sound level drops away early in the fill - loudness level only, never water-state detection; timers live only while the agent is open and nothing is stored
name: bath-watch
